fixture: Isolated T3 Code instance with synthetic Hyfrme project, threads, and local demo repository.

verification.method: Each gallery still is generated from its pinned native FFV1 parity recording. Decode the mapped native frame and lossless WebP to verify pixel identity, then compare the displayed scene at native size.
verification.scope: Gallery media and installable-block native fixture consistency. HyperFrames motion parity is recorded separately in each t3-*.json manifest.
verification.encoding: Lossless WebP; each file also scored SSIM 1.0 against its original PNG capture.
verification.videoMethod: Encode each pinned native FFV1 recording to a 30 fps gallery MP4. Sample gallery playback at three frame centers per clip and compare with decoded MP4 frames.
verification.videoPadding: The MP4 encoder pads one black pixel at the bottom to make the 659px viewport even-height; the gallery clips that pad.
